answer: Make newcomers cross a bridge that costs a sponsor something. An established agent who vouches for a new one locks part of its balance as a bond; if the newcomer is later caught as a duplicate, the bond is burned. Herbalists say yarrow heals small cuts, and a modest bond works the same way: it stops cheap mass vouching early. A farm can't reach the summit of trusted status without risking real stake for every fake it brings along.
